pick.name: Server-Sent Events from the API (Hono streamSSE / AI SDK streams)
pick.why: Covers LLM token streaming, progress and notifications with no extra service; works in Expo and Electron fetch

alts.name: Cloudflare Durable Objects / Agents SDK (WebSockets)
alts.why: Two-way realtime + per-user state when you outgrow SSE

alts.name: Zero (Rocicorp) sync engine
alts.why: Local-first instant UI + offline on web/mobile when collaboration matters

candidates.name: SSE (pick)
candidates.verdict: Simplest; one-way covers most AI app needs.

candidates.name: Durable Objects / Agents SDK
candidates.verdict: Wins for multiplayer/chat rooms or stateful agents on Cloudflare.

candidates.name: Zero
candidates.verdict: Wins for local-first collaborative apps on Postgres.

candidates.name: PowerSync
candidates.verdict: Best offline-first SQLite sync for mobile (Apache-2.0 SDKs; service source-available) - pick for heavy-offline Expo apps.

candidates.name: ElectricSQL / PGlite
candidates.verdict: Postgres read-path sync; good with TanStack DB.

candidates.name: Convex
candidates.verdict: Reactive backend with realtime by default; bigger platform commitment.

candidates.name: PartyKit
candidates.verdict: Folded into Cloudflare; npm last 2025 - don't start new.

decision: Start with SSE because it is free and needs no new service. Add Durable Objects for true two-way rooms, or a sync engine (Zero/PowerSync) only when offline or collaborative editing is a product requirement.

verify.note: Version/licence/limits match registry or official page.
